getCalendarResponse.name: missed-and-ended-days
getCalendarResponse.note: One get_calendar response (EF-1474). today is the account's calendar day; open_calendar wraps the same response as { view: 'calendar', record: { from, to, date, ...response }, related: {}, presentation }. Every day satisfies sessionCount = completed + inProgress + planned + missed + ended. Every program-backed day's summary carries programs (application EF-1575, marketplace 0.1.25): each contributing program once, in session order, with its own sessionCount; the counts sum to programSessionCount.

dayRoles.2026-09-07: trained by hand: an untapped occurrence satisfied by an unplanned completed workout, counted once
dayRoles.2026-09-09: mixed past day: a completed scheduled workout and a second schedule's untapped occurrence
dayRoles.2026-09-13: shared: two programs' untapped occurrences on a future day; programs credits each program once
dayRoles.2026-09-14: manual-led: a one-off planned workout leads a program's untapped occurrence, so the summary has no programId and programs names the program

prAwards.name: pr-award-kinds
prAwards.note: The application fixtures test/fixtures/mcp/progress-recent-prs.json and test/fixtures/mcp/personal-records.json (EF-1468, in the EF-1448 measurement contract), copied verbatim. getProgressRecentPrs is get_progress/open_progress record.recentPrs; getPersonalRecords is a get_personal_records response, whose data rows are open_exercise_progress related.records. type weight is Heaviest and type oneRm is Est. 1RM; an Est. 1RM row adds estimatedOneRm, the whole-unit Epley estimate of the lifted set (170 lb x 8 reads 215 lb).

executionGroups._note: EF-1552: grouped open_workout/open_template payloads as the application emits them; rest is the saved Activity after a set (an explicit 0 s rest, a rest after each round, two blocks in one slot).

record.title: Strength for Runners
record.summary: One strength session a week that fits around your running.
record.description: Jump squats after an easy ramp-up set, then Bulgarian split squats, Romanian deadlifts, slow calf raises and Copenhagen planks for the inner thighs and sides of the trunk. Volume stays low so the session fits beside your running week.
record.suitability: For runners with dumbbells and a bench. Copenhagen planks take some practice; keep the holds short.

record.title: Kraft für Einsteiger
record.summary: Ein fester Wochenplan mit der Langhantel, aufgebaut auf Fünfersätzen.
record.description: Kniebeuge, Bankdrücken, Kreuzheben und Schulterdrücken in Sätzen zu fünf Wiederholungen, mit Aufwärmsätzen, vollen Pausen sowie je einer Rücken- und Rumpfübung pro Tag. Die Woche wiederholt sich, und deine Gewichte werden aus dem geplant, was du tatsächlich protokollierst. Wähle zwei oder drei Tage pro Woche.
record.suitability: Für Einsteiger in einem Studio mit Langhantel, Rack, Bank, Latzug, Kabelzug und einer Kurzhantel, idealerweise nach ein paar Übungseinheiten der Grundübungen.

record.title: Short Conditioning
record.summary: Six hard 30-second rowing intervals in about 15 minutes.
record.description: A three-minute warm-up, six 30-second hard efforts with a minute of easy rowing between each, and a two-minute cool-down. Hard means a pace you could repeat six times, not an all-out sprint.
record.suitability: For anyone who can row comfortably. You need a rowing machine.

record.title: Base and Build Test Program
record.summary: Test content: two blocks of alternating bodyweight weeks.
record.description: A test program for checking blocks and alternating weeks. Weeks 1 to 4 are Base and weeks 5 to 8 are Build. In each block, Week A and Week B alternate, and Build adds a set to each exercise.
record.suitability: For automated tests only. It is never served outside a test environment.

record.title: Morning Yoga
record.summary: A short yoga sequence to start the day.
record.description: A minute of easy breathing in a cross-legged seat, child's pose and downward dog, a low lunge on each side, three slow rounds of sun salutation A, then warrior two and tree pose on each side. There is no countdown: hold each pose for about the time shown, and stay within a comfortable range.
record.suitability: For any level, including people new to yoga. Floor space only; a mat helps.

record.title: Dumbbell AMRAP
record.summary: A dumbbell AMRAP of snatches, squats, push-ups and rows.
record.description: As many rounds as you can in 15 minutes of dumbbell snatches, goblet squats, push-ups and rows.
record.suitability: For intermediate exercisers who can snatch a dumbbell with good form. You need a pair of dumbbells.

record.title: Bodyweight EMOM
record.summary: A short beginner EMOM with no equipment.
record.description: Every minute for 8 minutes, do 10 squats or 8 knee push-ups, alternating, and rest for what is left of the minute.

record.title: Bodyweight Tabata
record.summary: Two hard Tabatas with no equipment.
record.description: Two Tabatas, each eight rounds of 20 seconds hard and 10 seconds rest, alternating two moves.
record.suitability: For intermediate exercisers who already land jumps with control. Floor space only.

record.title: Dumbbell Strength and Chipper
record.summary: Heavier dumbbell work, then one round for time, in about 49 minutes.
record.description: Romanian deadlifts and floor presses for strength, then one round for time with an 18-minute cap.
record.suitability: For intermediate exercisers who can clean and snatch a dumbbell with good form. You need a pair of dumbbells and room for a few walking lunge steps.

record.title: Kurzhantel-AMRAP
record.summary: Ein Kurzhantel-AMRAP aus Reißen, Kniebeugen, Liegestützen und Rudern.
record.description: So viele Runden wie möglich in 15 Minuten aus Kurzhantel-Reißen, Goblet Squats, Liegestützen und Rudern.
record.suitability: Für Fortgeschrittene, die eine Kurzhantel sauber reißen können. Du brauchst ein Paar Kurzhanteln.

record.title: EMOM mit Körpergewicht
record.summary: Ein kurzes EMOM für Einsteiger, ohne Geräte.
record.description: Jede Minute 8 Minuten lang abwechselnd 10 Kniebeugen oder 8 Liegestütze auf den Knien, dann Pause für den Rest der Minute.
record.suitability: Für Einsteiger. Nur Platz auf dem Boden nötig.

record.title: Tabata mit Körpergewicht
record.description: Zwei Tabatas mit je acht Runden aus 20 Sekunden hart und 10 Sekunden Pause, abwechselnd zwei Übungen.
record.suitability: Für Fortgeschrittene, die Sprünge schon kontrolliert landen. Nur Platz auf dem Boden nötig.

record.title: Kurzhantel-Kraft und Chipper
record.summary: Schwerere Kurzhantelarbeit, dann eine Runde auf Zeit, in etwa 49 Minuten.
record.description: Rumänisches Kreuzheben und Bodendrücken für die Kraft, dann eine Runde auf Zeit mit einem Limit von 18 Minuten.
record.suitability: Für Fortgeschrittene, die eine Kurzhantel sauber umsetzen und reißen können. Du brauchst ein Paar Kurzhanteln und Platz für ein paar Schritte mit gehenden Ausfallschritten.
